## The problem

One or two sentences. Who needed an answer, and what was the question?
*Example: Which penguin species is heaviest, and does flipper length predict body mass?*

## My approach

What did you do, and why that way? Name the tools and the choices you made.

## The work

```{python}
import polars as pl
from lets_plot import *
LetsPlot.setup_html()

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "species": ["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"] * 3,
    "body_mass_g": [3700, 3730, 5076, 3680, 3790, 5000, 3720, 3750, 5100],
})
summary = df.group_by("species").agg(pl.col("body_mass_g").mean().round(0)).sort("species")
summary
```

```{python}
(ggplot(summary, aes("species", "body_mass_g", fill="species"))
 + geom_bar(stat="identity")
 + labs(title="Mean body mass by species (sample data)"))
```
